visualGuidance.role: Approved simple-inline style and quiet colour/contour treatment; supplied as image input.
Mei's character identity and uniform palette only; supplied as image input.

scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Travelling Umbrella”
Primary request: show the end of paragraph 3: at home, Mei carefully presses a small round white piece of repair tape over a tiny hole near the edge of her borrowed yellow umbrella. Her mother sits close by and has just offered a small roll of tape, warmly watching.
Scene/backdrop: a simple, calm Japanese home interior, with one low table and a quiet window; keep background objects sparse.
Subject: Mei has dark hair and wears a simple navy school uniform with a muted red bow. She focuses on placing the white circle over the hole in the yellow umbrella. Her mother sits beside her in simple muted teal and ivory clothes, holding the tape roll. The story cover is reference only for Mei’s identity, dark hair and uniform palette; do not copy its detailed rendering.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, simplified quiet background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape around 12:7, medium-wide, with the umbrella, hands and patch as the clear focal point, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft warm indoor daylight, caring and quietly industrious.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, ochre yellow and a restrained touch of terracotta red.
Constraints: depict only this repair moment, before Mei returns the umbrella to the station. Keep the canopy geometry and hands natural and readable. No lettering, signs, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: later station scene, boy, rain indoors, extra patches, busy props, malformed umbrella geometry, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, highly detailed background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Travelling Umbrella”
Primary request: show the end of paragraph 0: after school, Mei waits at the station entrance as rain begins, looking up because she did not bring an umbrella.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover, for Mei’s identity, dark hair and school-uniform palette only; Images 2–4 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings, for simple broad colour areas, gentle contours and minimal texture only.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet station entrance, with the roof sheltering Mei and soft blue-grey rain visible beyond it; keep architecture to a few broad shapes.
Subject: Mei is a Japanese schoolgirl with dark shoulder-length hair, a simple navy school uniform, white shirt and muted red bow, consistent with the cover. She stands under the station entrance looking toward the rainy sky; she has no umbrella. A small school bag may hang at her side.
Style/medium: gentle children’s picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7 for the reader, medium-wide; Mei is the clear focal subject with the station roof and rain as calm supporting shapes, two or three depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft overcast afternoon, briefly uncertain but calm.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, soft blue-grey rain and a restrained red accent.
Constraints: depict only the first paragraph’s moment. No umbrella in Mei’s hands or bag. No lettering, signs, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: the borrowed yellow umbrella, station staff, other people, busy station details, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, highly detailed background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story illustration for the graded-reader story “The Travelling Umbrella”
Primary request: show the end of paragraph 1: a station attendant kindly lends Mei a yellow umbrella and tells her she does not need to pay.
Input images: Image 1 is the story cover, for Mei’s identity, dark hair and school-uniform palette only; Images 2–4 are approved Kasa Jizō inline paintings, for simple broad colour areas, gentle contours and minimal texture only.
Scene/backdrop: the sheltered station entrance on a rainy day, shown with a few simple beams and the soft rain beyond the doorway; no readable signs or lettering.
Subject: Mei is the same Japanese schoolgirl with dark shoulder-length hair, navy school uniform, white shirt and muted red bow. A kind adult station attendant in a simple muted teal uniform offers her one closed bright yellow umbrella. Mei holds out one small coin; the attendant gently raises an open hand to show that no payment is needed. Keep their expressions warm and understated.
Style/medium: gentle children’s picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7 for the reader, medium-wide; the yellow umbrella is the focal object between Mei and the attendant, two or three depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft rainy daylight, kind and reassuring.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, ochre yellow, blue-grey rain and a restrained red accent.
Constraints: one Mei, one adult attendant, one closed yellow umbrella and one coin; depict only paragraph 1. Keep hands natural. No lettering, signs, badges with text, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: the umbrella-return box, repair patch, the later boy, extra umbrellas, crowds, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, highly detailed background.
